notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894003/5cda56d374bd920d6bac4272e3dddb2cc5e85c4b.png[/img]

[h3]Take the fight against Memphis-X and defend Kevin's room against his old toys in Toy Shire: Room One![/h3]

[b]Play through 3 levels inside Kevin's Room.[/b] Hold fast against the assault of Memphis-X and the other vengeful toys to defend the room. [b]Play Toy Shire: Room One now for free![/b]
